rationale: Builds on the 9x512 staged reverse-tail best by changing only the late quant-aware training objective. Early training keeps the proven full-token loss; once the existing int8 roundtrip endgame starts, gradients switch to the final-eval suffix window (64 tokens by default), matching the doc-isolated stride scoring path while preserving the exact final int8+zlib evaluation and artifact format. The script is self-contained: it expands the complete modified training source at launch.
title: Quant-Aware Suffix-Loss Endgame
